name: Darkstar Bloomfield
introDiscord: Darkstar Anemones bloom beneath a skyless trench, glowing only when approached indirectly. Glimmer apparently discovered it can dim itself here and immediately abused this power.
introTwitch: Darkstar Anemones bloom beneath a skyless trench, glowing only when approached indirectly. Glimmer apparently discovered it can dim itself here and immediately abused this power.

darkstar-bloomfield-approach.prompt: Three routes wind through dark blossoms.

left.message: A Darkstar Anemone snaps shut around the route.

right.message: A meteor-iron reliquary rests beneath a field of closed blooms.

forward.message: Shizuki's tonic reads: "Glimmer learned stealth. This is a problem."
forward.fullHpMessage: You leave the tonic. Somewhere nearby, Glimmer's old prank energy remains spiritually present.

left.message: Star Candies glow beneath several sleeping anemones.

right.message: A Darkstar Anemone opens directly beneath you.

forward.message:
A Berry floats beside Shizuki's note:

"Glimmer disappeared for ten minutes.

Glimmer was directly behind me.

Trust damaged."

darkstar-bloomfield-threshold.prompt: Three flower-lined paths converge on Sunless Corolla.

left.message: Shizuki's bottle is labeled: "For flower bites and emotional betrayal by tiny glowing friends."
left.fullHpMessage: You leave the betrayal medicine untouched.

right.message: A star-chart coffer rests beneath a giant closed bloom.

forward.message:
"A Darkstar Anemone opens across the final route."

BOSS:

bossPromptDiscord:
Every flower closes.

One enormous bloom begins opening inside Sunless Corolla.

Use /yes to approach or /no to leave before the entire garden decides you are fertilizer.
bossPromptTwitch:
Every flower closes.

One enormous bloom begins opening inside Sunless Corolla.

Use !yes to approach or !no to leave before the entire garden decides you are fertilizer.
bossRetreatText: You retreat. The smaller flowers slowly reopen behind you.

boss.revealText:
The colossal dark bloom unfolds.

Umbra Bloom Sovereign reveals itself!

completionText:
"The Sovereign closes and sinks into the bloomfield.

A tiny light flickers behind a flower.

You suddenly understand Shizuki's Glimmer problem."
